content: Kunhalalicha Chapanga
Nnyendelela kupalana ngita chiipalwa kwa bhando bhibhannyeketii Kilichitu.
Nkoto kujhewa kwapokela akaghene ukajha kwino, kwa nhwalo kuhenga yenio bhando bhange bhakapokii akatumiche bha kunane kwa Chapanga changamanya.
Makomboka bhala bhibhabhii mu kipungo ngita hela mangota ntabhitwe pamonga na bheniya, makomboka bhala bhibhang'ahika ngita hela na mangota ming'ahika ngita bheniya.
Ipalwa bhando bhibhatoline bhahechimimwa na bhando bhoha, bhipalwa jhe kutenda ngongola na mundo jhonge. Chapanga nabhahadabula bhibhakena na ngongola.
Nkoto kubhehe bhando bhimipala hake mbijha, nambo ntocheka na ilebhe iminayo. Chapanga ilonge: “Naninneka ng'o, hilu nanintagha ng'o.”
Ndi nhwalo tuhoto kulonge changajhoghopa:
Makomboka ilongoche hino, bhibhatangachila Lilobhe lya Mbone lya Chapanga. Nkomboka chibhatamita na chibhajhomolila utamo gwabhe, mukikengame kihobholelo chabhe.
Yecho Kilichitu ndi jhojhola jhola, dicho, deleno na machiko ghoha ghangapeta.

Nkoto kujhembeluwa na mabholo ghoghoha gha kighene ghighantenda mpoghele kone na kone. Umbone gwa Chapanga ndi ukangamalicha miojho jhito hilu chi lilaghalikilo lya chakulyegha, nhwalo malaghalikillo gheniya ghatangatii jhe bhando bhala bhibhakengima.
Twenga tukwete kichangwale, bhala bhibhahenga lihengo mwenio mu lihema lela cha Akayahude, bhipalwa jhe kulye ilebhe ya peniya pa kachangwale.
Mpiya litambiko Nkolongwa jwa Akayahude ileta miyahe jha kinyama mu Unyahinyahi Hake na kubhoha litambiko nhwalo gwa uhakaho, nambo yegha jha kinyama ujhochwa panja jha kigwenio.
Ndi nhwalo Yecho jwenio, kupala abhajhelebhule bhando kwa miyahe jhake, akang'ahike na kuwe panja jha muche.
Bhahe, tunnyendelela kwenio panja jha kigwenio tukabhehe na hone ngita chapatita hone.
Nhwalo pamba pannema tukwetii jhe muche ghutamikii machiko ghoha, nambo tulolekeya muche ghola ghuhika.
Ngohe kwa ndela ya Yecho, tumpele Chapanga litambiko lya kunumbilila machiko ghoha. Ghono lumbililo ghupita munnomo gwito putulonge kubhehe Yecho ndi Bhambo.
Nkoto kujhewa kutendelana ghambone na kutangatilana, nhwalo gheniya ndi matambiko ghighanhalalicha Chapanga.

Majhokanikiye ilongoche hino na kukengama malaghilo ghabhe. Bheniya bhilolekeya mangota changatotokela, bhipalwa bhanongelela Chapanga chibhantumikile. Anda majhokanikiye nabhahenga lihengo lyabhe kwa kuhangana, anda majhokanikiye jhe nabhahenga lihengo kwa kukokoleka, na kilebhe chenie nakitangatila jhe mangota.
Mutujhopelela kwa Chapanga. Chakaka tumanya tubhii na miojho itulangii tukwetii jhe malemo, nhwalo tupalwa kuhenga lyambone kwa kila kilebhe.
Nimpembekeya hake unyopelela kupala Chapanga ammujhiche kajhombe kwino.
Kunnyopa Chapanga kwa kujhomolela
Ngohe Chapanga jwayokiche Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu, ndi nnucha Nkolongwa jwa Mambelele kwa miyahe jhake. Kwa miyahe jhene alilangii kubhehe Lilaghano lya machiko ghoha ghangapeta ndi uchakaka.

Ninyopa Chapanga jwa uteeke ampela kila kilebhe chambone chimipala, kupala ntende ghapala jwenio, na kupete Kilichitu antende ghala ghaghapala nkate jhito. Ung'alicho ubhehe kwa Yecho Kilichitu, machiko ghoha ghangapeta! Amina.
Malobhe gha kujhomolela
Bhahe, akalongo bhango, nipembelekeya hake mpokele malobhe ghanga ghakuleke mwojho kwa kuhimbilila. Jhenje ndi baluwa nyipe ndo jhininyandikile.
Mbala umanye kubhehe nnongo gwito Timocheyo alekekiwe mu kipungo. Anda ahikite ngohe, nahika nako kutyangila kwenio.
Majhambuche ilongoche bhino bhoha pamonga na bhando bhoha bha Chapanga! Makalongo bha kilambo cha ku Italiya bhinyambucha.
Umbone gwa Chapanga ubhaha na mangota mabhoha. Amina!
